part_number.product: SEL-411L Current Differential Relay with Full Distance Backup Protection

prefix.description: SEL-411L Current Differential Relay (fixed model prefix)

part_number.note: 23-character MOT string. Positions and option codes were calibrated directly against the WI-8762 part-number template columns (vector art read via rendered PNGs). The drawing layers (model_to_layers) confirm positions 6, 16, 18, 20 and 22, but their nominal source positions for the connector (7), Ethernet connection (8), serial channel 1 (11) and serial channel 2 (13) are shifted low because the layers omit the conformal-coat, power-supply and secondary-input digits; the WI-8762 columns place those at 9, 12, 13 and 14 respectively. Validated by the device drawing-selection examples, which decode cleanly: 0411L...H424XXXX = 4U/1 board, ...H57474XX = 5U/2 boards, ...H6247424 = 6U/3 boards.
references: SEL-411L 400-series master configuration drawings i7029.L / i7240.E (drawing layers)

example_part_numbers.note: From device drawing-selection set (i7029.L): std FW, no conformal, 125-250V PS, screw terminals, 5 A, IEC 61850 protocols, 2x10/100BASE-T+2x100BASE-FX, ch1 1300nm, ch2 850nm C37.94, horizontal rack, 4U one I/O board B=(8DI/13FormA/2FormC)@125Vdc
From device drawing-selection set (i7031.L): as above but 5U, two I/O boards B & C both (8DI/13HCI/2FormC)@125Vdc
From device drawing-selection set (i7251.F): 6U chassis, three I/O boards B/C/D = (8DI/13FormA)@125, (8DI/13HCI)@125, (8DI/13FormA)@125

positions.label: Firmware
positions.note: WI-8762 annotates option A with a linked 'C' in the Ethernet/87L position (11), indicating firmware A is ordered together with the IEC 61850 + 87L communications option. Option B is present in the drawing layers but not shown on WI-8762.

options.0: Standard Current Differential and Distance Element (single/dual breaker, single/three-pole tripping)
options.1: Standard Plus Sub-cycle Distance Elements, Series Compensation Logic and Traveling-Wave Fault Location
options.A: Standard Current Differential and Distance Element for Single Breaker, Three-Pole Tripping Applications
options.B: Standard Current Differential and Distance Element for Single Breaker, Single/Three-Pole Tripping Applications

positions.label: Connector Type
positions.note: Drawing layer GROUP_2 nominally lists position 7; corrected to 9 per the WI-8762 template columns.

positions.label: Ethernet Communications Protocols and 87L Line Current Differential
positions.note: 'None' is shown as X in both this position and the Ethernet Connection Options digit (12).

options.B: FTP, Telnet, Synchrophasors and DNP3 LAN/WAN
options.C: FTP, Telnet, Synchrophasors, DNP3 LAN/WAN and IEC 61850

positions.label: Ethernet Connection Options
positions.note: Drawing layer GROUP_3 nominally lists position 8; corrected to 12 per the WI-8762 template columns. Code 9 (two 100-1000BASE + three 100BASE SFP ports) appears only in the 400-series drawing layers, not on WI-8762.

positions.label: Serial Line Current Differential Communications Channel 1
positions.note: Drawing layer GROUP_4 nominally lists position 11; corrected to 13 per the WI-8762 template columns.

positions.label: Serial Line Current Differential Communications Channel 2
positions.note: Drawing layer GROUP_5 nominally lists position 13; corrected to 14 per the WI-8762 template columns.

positions.label: Fixed digit
positions.note: Fixed digit in the WI-8762 template (always X).

positions.label: Chassis
positions.note: Determines how many I/O board slots exist; unused I/O slots are filled with X.

options.5: 5U, Up to Two I/O Boards (positions B, C)
options.6: 6U, Up to Three I/O Boards (positions B, C, D)

positions.label: I/O Board Position B (type | input voltage)
positions.note: Two-digit slot: first digit = I/O board type, second digit = board input voltage. Option codes/descriptions here follow WI-8762.
